command:
set -eu
proof_dir=$(mktemp -d /run/inventory-logrotate-proof.XXXXXX)
proof_tag="copytruncate-$(date +%s)"
sh -c '
log_path=$1
proof_dir=$2
proof_tag=$3
exec 3>>"$log_path"
printf "writer_pid=%s phase=before marker=%s-before\\n" "$$" "$proof_tag" >&3
: > "$proof_dir/ready"
while [ ! -e "$proof_dir/continue" ]; do sleep 0.1; done
printf "writer_pid=%s phase=after marker=%s-after\\n" "$$" "$proof_tag" >&3
exec 3>&-
: > "$proof_dir/done"
' sh /var/log/inventory/app.log "$proof_dir" "$proof_tag" &
writer_pid=$!
for attempt in $(seq 1 100); do
    [ -e "$proof_dir/ready" ] && break
    sleep 0.1
done
[ -e "$proof_dir/ready" ]
before_inode=$(stat -c %i /var/log/inventory/app.log)
printf 'writer_pid=%s proof_tag=%s inode_before=%s\n' "$writer_pid" "$proof_tag" "$before_inode"
logrotate --force --verbose --state "$proof_dir/state" /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app 2>&1
after_inode=$(stat -c %i /var/log/inventory/app.log)
: > "$proof_dir/continue"
wait "$writer_pid"
[ -e "$proof_dir/done" ]
printf 'inode_after=%s same_inode=%s\n' "$after_inode" "$([ "$before_inode" = "$after_inode" ] && printf yes || printf no)"
printf '%s\n' '--- rotation files ---'
ls -l /var/log/inventory/app.log /var/log/inventory/app.log.*
printf '%s\n' '--- compressed rotation integrity/content ---'
gzip -t /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz
zgrep -F "$proof_tag-before" /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz
printf '%s\n' '--- active log received post-rotation write from same writer ---'
grep -F "$proof_tag-after" /var/log/inventory/app.log
printf '%s\n' '--- active log metadata ---'
stat -c 'path=%n mode=%a owner=%U group=%G size=%s inode=%i selinux=%C' /var/log/inventory/app.log
printf '%s\n' '--- parsed retention policy ---'
logrotate --debug /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app 2>&1 | grep -E 'rotating pattern:|\(7 rotations\)|compress|copytruncate' || true
